verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is the product's core interaction model. The docs say the Kimi Code Agent reads code, edits files, runs commands and verifies results "through conversation" in the desktop app, terminal and editor sidebar. The consumer app invites users to "just ask, or do an Agent task" and supports agent mode and multi-turn web building. Community users confirm prompt-driven use, though some report overthinking or broken code when running tasks (partly via third-party tools). missing for 10: consistent independent hands-on evidence that natural-language agent tasks complete reliably, and in-depth first-party docs on agent mode limits (only titles are shown).
